description: $0.02 per call. Returns a complete, unsigned Solana transaction that creates an SPL mint, writes Metaplex metadata on-chain, mints the supply to the payer and revokes the mint authority in the same transaction. NON-CUSTODIAL: the service never sees a private key — the caller signs with their own wallet. Requires a payer public key. Test on devnet first.

mint_pubkey.description: Supply your own mint public key if you would rather hold that keypair yourself

network.description: mainnet-beta (default) or devnet — devnet costs nothing, try it first

payer.description: Base58 PUBLIC key of the wallet that pays rent and signs. A private key is never accepted.

supply.description: Total supply in UI units as an exact integer string

symbol.description: Token symbol, 1-10 characters, uppercase letters and digits

uri.description: https:// or ipfs:// URL of the metadata JSON

name: sol_build_launch_tx
title: Build a Solana token launch transaction
